about: The Mention rules (CONTEXT.md, issue #83), as cases every app's matcher must pass: lib/mentions.js, web, Android, Mac.
maxRows: the most suggestion rows shown at once.
shortNames: [name, short name] pairs. Words are joined, each capitalised; only letters, digits, '_' and '-' are kept.

worlds: the bots (the Chief included, as id 'chief'), their jobs and picked skills, and the skill library; account: the Claude account's skills, which '/' also runs (after the library's, minus names the library has) unless the bot's disabledSkills names them (#236). A bot with useSkills false has no skills.
cases: { name, world, chat, text?, matches?, typed?, suggestions? }. chat is 'chief' or a bot id: skills in scope are the whole library in the Chief chat, the bot's picked skills in its own chat.
matches: the mentions found in text, in order, as { kind: bot|job|skill, text, bot?, job?, skill? } (bot and job are ids, skill a name; text is the part of the message that is the mention).

suggestions: the rows offered while the text before the cursor is typed, in order, as the text a pick inserts (followed by a space). [] means no list. Rows: bots, then jobs, then skills; a skill named like a bot is left out; after '@Bot/' only that bot's jobs; matching is a case-insensitive 'contains' on the short name.

picks: { name, world, chat, before, pick, after, jobsNext }. before and after are the whole message with '|' where the cursor is. pick is the text of the suggested row (for the text before the cursor) that is picked. Picking puts the row's text in place of the '@…' before the cursor and the rest of that word, then a space unless a space (not a line break) follows already; the cursor goes after the space. jobsNext: a bot was picked and the space is new, so a '/' typed next replaces the space and lists the bot's jobs.
renamed: the team with the Chief named by the owner (#41). '@ChiefOfStaff' still means the Chief beside its name, and is not suggested.

group: a group's chat with all true (#124): '@all' is offered first while it is typed at the start of the message, and is no member's mention: a member named All is neither matched nor suggested there. Elsewhere '@all' is nothing of its own.

Commands (#237): '/' at the very start of the message in a bot's own chat lists that bot's skills (its picked skills, as for mentions; none when useSkills is false), filtered by a case-insensitive 'contains' on the name, at most maxRows. A row's text is '/' and the skill's name; picking it replaces the '/…' word as a mention pick does. Never in the Chief chat or a group. Once a space follows the name, no list.

commands: { name, world, chat, text, command }. command is what sending text runs: { skill, args } (args: the rest of the message after the name, trimmed), or null when it is plain text (no '/' at the very start, a name the bot has no skill of, a name joined to more text, the Chief chat, a group).
